schema.description: Every field is optional; an omitted (or 0) numeric field takes the built-in default policy value (v0). A value outside the range below is 422 validation-failed.

offerTtlMinutes.description: How long a quote stays QUOTED (also capped by the pickup cutoff).

holdTtlMinutes.description: How long a PROVISIONAL promise holds capacity before ReleaseExpiredHolds.

packagesPerOrder.description: Declared packages per order; converts orders to departure packages (G9). Default 1 when omitted or 0.

capacitySharePercent.description: Proportional share of the node cutoff capacity the promise side may use (G9 "D4"). Default 100 when omitted or 0.

orderDeadlines.description: At most one deadline per (tier, regionId); a duplicate is 422 validation-failed.

regionId.description: The destination region; absent means every region.

localTime.description: Order deadline HH:mm in the destination delivery station's time zone.
